sources.title: Google Hotels / public Google listing

sources.findings: D36/1 August Kunda Road, Jangambari, 221001. Phone +91 80817 09146. Three-star classification. Walking distance to temple/ghat. AC, Wi-Fi, restaurant, front desk, room service. Noon/11am timings. No pool/spa. Other amenity/policy data conflicts with OTAs.

sources.title: MakeMyTrip property detail
sources.access: Web search full property excerpt, crawled two weeks before research
sources.findings: Deluxe, Deluxe Twin Bed and Family categories; on-site pure vegetarian restaurant; complimentary Wi-Fi, 24h room service, lift. D36/1 Godowlia/Jangambadi. Typical noon/11am. Unmarried couples allowed/local IDs disallowed in this snapshot. Rate plans separately include breakfast. Avoid its incorrect UNESCO claim about Sarnath Deer Park.

sources.title: Booking.com Hotel Augusto
sources.access: Search index returned substantial property excerpt (last month); direct open produced JavaScript robot-verification page
sources.findings: D36/1 Godowlia/Dasaswmedh/Jangambari road. AC family rooms, private bathrooms, toiletries, room service, 24h front desk, lounge, sun terrace, luggage storage, laundry, paid shuttle. Breakfast available; rate inclusion unknown. Phone hidden until booking. 6.2/10 from 37 reviews.

sources.title: Tripadvisor Hotel Augusto
sources.access: Web open returned full page, crawled last month
sources.findings: 4.0/5, 44 reviews; D36/1 Jangambari Road near temple/Godowlia. AC, housekeeping, room service, family rooms. Formerly OYO 4009. Claimed 45 rooms and pets allowed conflict with other channels. Guest photographs mixed with property images; do not assume reuse permission. Review mentions Aroma of Kashi but relationship unverified.

sources.title: Goibibo room inventory
sources.access: Web search room-page excerpt, crawled last month
sources.findings: Deluxe Room: double bed, 150 sq ft. Deluxe Twin Room: two single beds, 270 sq ft. Four-bed Family Room: two king beds, 210 sq ft. Each lists one bathroom. Separate room-only and breakfast rates. Room size and maximum occupancy should be confirmed before publication.

sources.title: Agoda Hotel Augusto
sources.access: English page shell only; indexed Japanese page crawled four months before research
sources.findings: Matching D36/1 address. Free Wi-Fi, 24h front desk, restaurant, family rooms, luggage storage and airport transfer. Older Standard room name and size differ from Indian OTA inventory; do not add an unconfirmed fourth category.

sources.title: Trip.com Hotel Augusto
sources.access: Web search detailed property excerpt, last month
sources.findings: Alternate phone +91-8707451949. Renovated 2025 claim not corroborated. 26 rooms in structured detail, 20 in description. 11am-noon check-in/10am checkout differs from Indian OTAs. Restaurant, 24h front desk/service, Wi-Fi, laundry, family facilities. No pets.

sources.title: Expedia India Hotel Augusto
sources.access: Web search detailed excerpt, last month
sources.findings: Onsite restaurant, public-area Wi-Fi, AC, 24h front desk/room service, daily housekeeping, television, toiletries, electric kettle. Address opposite SBI, Jangambari Road. No on-site parking. 11am-noon check-in/10am checkout. Photos identify lobby, exterior, bedrooms and bathroom.

sources.title: Hotels.com India Hotel Augusto
sources.access: Web search detailed excerpt; variants last week/last month
sources.findings: 20 rooms. Indian-cuisine restaurant, AC, Wi-Fi, 24h front desk/service. No onsite parking; nearby paid parking listed. 11am-noon check-in/10am checkout. No pets. Breakfast inclusion and cancellation vary by rate. 6.6/10 from four reviews. Treat Expedia corroboration as same data family.

sources.title: Dashashwamedh Ghat, Kashi official portal
sources.access: Public indexed page crawled research day
sources.findings: Ghat is close to Kashi Vishwanath Temple; known for evening Ganga Aarti and riverboats. Supports destination copy only, not hotel-provided tours, bookings, guaranteed schedules or transport.

sources.title: Shree Kashi Vishvanath Temple, Varanasi district
sources.access: Public indexed page crawled last week
sources.findings: Temple dedicated to Lord Shiva on the western Ganga bank; one of twelve Jyotirlingas. Supports short devotional context. Do not reuse the page's old transport schedules without separate current verification.

sources.title: Places of Tourist Attraction, Varanasi district
sources.access: Public indexed page crawled research day
sources.findings: Describes dawn views of the riverfront/ghats and boats available to hire at Dashashwamedh. Supports sunrise river experience, not an included hotel service.
